tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Upper Town: Begin your day wandering through Zagreb’s historic Upper Town — medieval alleys, charming corners and the iconic Stone Gate with its quiet shrine. → | 🎨 St. Mark’s Square: Admire the famous tiled roof and colorful façades surrounding one of Croatia’s most photogenic squares. → | 🕍 Zagreb Cathedral: Visit the tallest building in Croatia — an impressive Gothic cathedral full of history and atmosphere. → | ☕ Coffee in Tkalča (Tkalčićeva Street): Take a relaxed break on Zagreb’s liveliest café street with cozy terraces and vibrant façades.; Afternoon: 🏙️ Lower Town Walk: Explore the Green Horseshoe — a chain of elegant parks, tree-lined avenues, museums and grand Austro-Hungarian architecture. → | 🎭 Museum of Broken Relationships: Discover a unique museum filled with personal stories and emotional exhibits — quirky, moving and one of Zagreb’s cultural gems. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Local Specialties: Enjoy štrukli, roasted turkey dishes, hearty soups or vegetarian local meals.; Sunset: 🌅 Bundek or Jarun Lakes: Head to Zagreb’s favorite lake areas for soft sunset colors, calm reflections and a golden-hour atmosphere.; Night: 🌃 Evening Walk Through the Center: End your day with a gentle nighttime stroll — glowing streets, dessert cafés and a friendly city vibe ideal for unwinding.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Diocletian’s Palace: Begin your day inside the ancient Roman palace — a living labyrinth of stone arches, Peristyle square, narrow marble lanes and 1,700-year-old walls. The mix of history, life and atmosphere here is unbeatable. → | ⛪ St. Domnius Cathedral & Bell Tower: Climb the tower for one of the best panoramas in Split — red rooftops, sea horizon and the full palace structure beneath you. A short climb with a huge reward. → | ☕ Coffee on the Riva: Take a relaxed seaside break on Split’s iconic promenade — palm trees, boats, gentle waves and the best Mediterranean morning vibe.; Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town Wander: Explore the stone-paved alleys around the palace — tiny squares, artisan shops, hidden courtyards and local charm everywhere you turn. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Dalmatian Specialties: Enjoy fresh seafood, buzara-style mussels, pašticada, grilled fish or light Mediterranean veggie plates — all bursting with flavor and perfect for a coastal lunch.; Sunset: 🌅 Marjan Hill Viewpoint: Hike or take an easy walk up to Marjan for Split’s legendary sunset — golden light over the city, islands in the distance and the sea glowing below you. One of the most magical views in Dalmatia.; Night: 🌃 Riva Night Walk: End the day with a gentle stroll along the Riva — soft lights, music, gelato stands, sea breeze and a relaxed Mediterranean vibe perfect for unwinding.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🧱 City Walls Walk: Start your day walking Dubrovnik’s legendary stone walls — morning light, open sea views, terracotta rooftops and fewer crowds make this the perfect time. Every corner brings a new postcard moment. → | 🏰 Old Town Exploration: Wander through marble-paved Stradun, narrow stone alleys, arches, small squares and historic buildings — the true medieval soul of Dubrovnik. → | ☕ Coffee on Stradun: Take a break in one of the cafés along the main street with smooth stone pavement, elegant façades and lively morning charm.; Afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: Take a short boat ride to the peaceful island paradise — pine forests, rocky cliffs, swimming spots, botanical gardens and friendly peacocks roaming freely. A perfect escape from the city buzz. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Dalmatian Favorites: Enjoy mussels in buzara sauce, seafood risotto, grilled fish or light Mediterranean vegetarian dishes — fresh, coastal and full of flavor.; Sunset: 🌅 Fort Lovrijenac Viewpoint: Watch the sun dip behind the Adriatic from the iconic fortress overlooking the Old Town — golden light over stone walls, waves crashing below and one of Dubrovnik’s most dramatic viewpoints.; Night: 🌃 Stradun Night Stroll & Gelato: End the day with a relaxed nighttime walk through softly lit marble streets, warm sea breeze and a perfect gelato to finish your Dubrovnik adventure.
